integrity: The Cayley-graph isomorphism is proved from the order-three coset decomposition, and the separating character sums are computed from fixed-point counts. A standalone verifier reconstructs the low-rank character-degree boundary and explicitly checks the two Cayley graphs for A7 and A8.
scientific_limitations: The theorem starts at n=7 and does not classify A5 or A6.
For n>=9 the proof uses the classical uniqueness of the degree-(n-1) irreducible character of A_n; the n=7,8 cases are independently checked by hook-length computation.
The 2015 predecessor article was only partially accessible during literature comparison, leaving a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Alternating groups fail the Babai character-sum invariant via triangle Cayley graphs
